summary: Moved all date/time parsing into deskstats/timeparse.py and rewired the modules to use it; tests pass and I added tests/test_timeparse.py. The guide lists chats as TRUNCATE in its table but NEAREST_EVEN in 2.3 and the changelog; I kept current behaviour (nearest even). Overflow/inf epochs now raise ValueError instead of OverflowError (calls.log with inf now gives a DataError instead of a crash).
